name: global-job-postings
title: Global Job Postings API — Workday, Greenhouse & 66 Sources
description: Query 6.3M+ active job postings and 72,000+ company records across 240+ countries. Search Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, iCIMS, SAP SuccessFactors and other supported sources by country, technology, seniority, workplace, keyword, or date.

envVars.name: NIVULT_API_KEY
envVars.description: Internal Nivult index key; stored as an Actor secret, never in the repository

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

apify-default-dataset-item.eventDescription: One job or company record in the default dataset.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Align the repository with the live flat pay-per-event configuration; tiered pricing is prepared separately and is not active.
